propositions: Nested retries across subprocess, SDK, wrapper, and reconciler layers can exceed request budget or replay after ambiguous commit on non-idempotent ticket writes.
A provider-neutral logical-operation contract with immutable operation/outcome values and centralized fake-clock retry-budget ownership must consolidate retry decision logic into one place.
The retry budget permits exactly three physical invocations with at most 15,000 ms cumulative sleep, deterministic jitter schedule [2s,3s) then [4s,5s), and provider delays as lower bounds.

Diagnostic entries must be sanitized, limited to six allowed keys, truncated at 512 Unicode code points, capped at eight entries with overflow sentinel, and serialized canonically to byte-identical JSON.
After ambiguous writes, observation of desired primary-store postcondition returns recovered; failed or inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown with replay_safety forbidden.
